step: Removed: cancellation invoice (invoice number starts with C)
Removed: non-sale invoice (invoice number with another letter, e.g. A = bad-debt adjustment)
Removed: missing or invalid invoice date
Removed: non-merchandise line (postage, carriage, fees, discounts, manual entries, samples, vouchers)
Removed: missing, zero or negative quantity (return or stock adjustment)
Removed: missing, zero or negative unit price
Removed: exact duplicate of an earlier row
Merged: repeated product in the same invoice (merged into one basket line)
Invoices with two or more products
Valid invoices without a customer ID (kept)
